_comment: Shipped DEFAULT **CLOSE** gate, the second half of the build/close split. It runs at the END of a phase, after the evidence pass has verified each acceptance criterion and ticked the boxes, and it is the last thing between a phase and being recorded as closed. Run it explicitly: `node checkpoint.mjs --manifest <path-to-this-file>`. A per-phase copy lives at docs/checkpoints/phase-<N>-close.json and is what phase-complete actually runs.
_why_two_files: The acceptance-criteria row can only pass AFTER the evidence exists. Put it in the build gate and the first close fails by construction, and the only way through is to tick the boxes to go green — evidence-then-tick inverted into tick-to-go-green. So the build gate (checkpoint-manifest.json) omits it and this one requires it.
_close_record: The per-phase copy of this file doubles as the close RECORD. build-phase scaffolds docs/checkpoints/phase-<N>-close.json with "closed": false; phase-complete flips it to true, and only after this gate exits zero. scripts/state.mjs reads a phase as closed when that file exists WITHOUT "closed": false, so scaffolding it without the key would mark the phase closed the moment the fork started. This shipped default carries no "closed" key because it is a template of checks, not a record of one phase.
_tokens: {{PLUGIN_SCRIPTS}} expands to the directory this manifest ships in. checkpoint.mjs does the substitution.
